lighting_shading.note: Bright specular highlights define the curved brass surfaces.

value_contrast.note: High contrast between the bright gold and cyan background.

color_palette.note: Vibrant gold and red pop against the cool cyan rays.

composition_hierarchy.note: Strong diagonal composition leads the eye from bell to mouthpiece.

shape_proportions.note: Smooth, rounded forms with a highly readable trumpet silhouette.

viewpoint_depth.note: Three-quarter view shows the depth of the instrument's tubing.

edges_linework.note: Clean edges defined by shading rather than drawn outlines.

surface_finish.note: High-gloss metallic finish with a stylized, clean look.

pose_rhythm.note: Dynamic tilt and radiating background create a sense of motion.
